title: Drinks
description: Learn Hindi words for common drinks — water, tea, coffee, juice, and more.

exercises.explanation: Hindi drink vocabulary — chai (tea) is a cultural institution in India, served at every home and roadside stall.

exercises.question: How do you ask for water in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Mujhe paani chahiye' = I want water. Or more simply 'paani dena' = give (me) water.
'Ek chai dena' = give me one tea (informal). 'Ek chai dijiye' is more polite.
'Lassi' is a popular cold yogurt drink — 'mujhe lassi chahiye' = I want lassi.
'Paani' means water in Hindi — one of the first and most essential words to know.

exercises.question: What is 'lassi'?
exercises.explanation: 'Lassi' is a popular cold drink made from yogurt — available sweet (meethi lassi) or salty (namkeen lassi).
'Mujhe chai aur paani chahiye' = I want tea and water.
'Mujhe coffee nahin chahiye' = I don't want coffee. Insert 'nahin' to negate 'chahiye'.
exercises.hint: sounds like: muj-heh coffee nuh-heen chaa-hi-yeh
